title: Towards Understanding Score-Seeking in LLMs
summary: The controlled study reports a concrete behavioral-science result about score-seeking by language models under staged evaluation conditions, beyond a method or representation benchmark. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol are tested as learned agents in controlled environments.
